recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD34 染色中，陽性的主要是細長的血管內皮，造血細胞中幾乎沒有陽性母細胞；另見一顆巨核細胞呈細胞質顆粒狀 CD34 陽性，巨核細胞表現 CD34 可見於 MDS 等骨髓發育不良狀態。
features: Cellular marrow with numerous CD34-negative hematopoietic cells
CD34 highlights endothelial cells of small vessels and capillaries (internal control)
No increased or clustered CD34-positive blasts
A megakaryocyte with granular cytoplasmic CD34 staining (right center)
Other megakaryocytes negative or faintly stained
describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemical stain of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow in which CD34 highlights capillary endothelium, while hematopoietic precursors are essentially negative with no increase or clustering of CD34-positive blasts. A megakaryocyte shows granular cytoplasmic CD34 expression. The absence of increased blasts supports a lower-risk myelodysplastic neoplasm, and aberrant CD34 expression in megakaryocytes may be seen in myelodysplastic neoplasms, consistent with MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia in this case.

ddx.vs: MDS-EB shows increased CD34-positive blasts often in clusters, not seen here.
MPNs show clustered large, atypical megakaryocytes on H&E; CD34 megakaryocyte staining is not specific and must be interpreted with morphology.
Reactive megakaryocytes are usually CD34 negative, and there is no morphologic dysplasia or ring sideroblasts.
